caveats: Counts are the served Research Alpha set (release policy alpha-2026-10-27e), samples that passed QC; a study is counted once per species or chemistry it has samples of.
10x 5' libraries carry the 3' chemistry label they were counted with.
Cell counts are Singlet's knee-filter calls on reads capped at the first 30M of the first SRA run; they undercount against Cell Ranger and EmptyDrops.
